verdict.rationale: Modal's docs and community evidence show strong support for massive parallel/concurrent execution (thousands to hundreds of thousands of concurrent sandboxes/rollout environments), which underlies bulk operations across many items, and this is corroborated by a hands-on community build (self-hosted CI runners scaling via Modal Sandboxes). However, there's no explicit documentation of a bulk API (e.g., batch-create, batch-query, or bulk-file-operation primitives) — the evidence focuses on scaling compute environments rather than bulk data/item processing workflows specifically. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API documentation, first-party examples of processing many discrete items (not just many sandboxes) in one call, independent benchmarks of bulk throughput.
